summary: `eas update --channel production --message ...` omits `--environment`, which the Expo docs mark "required in SDK 55 and later" (docs.expo.dev/eas-update/getting-started/; SDK 55 changelog: "eas update now requires the --environment flag"), so the command as taught fails on the SDK the course installs (57).

summary: States the default branch is `main` and the exercise runs `git init` then `git push -u origin main`, but Git 2.x still creates `master` unless init.defaultBranch is set (verified with git 2.53: "hint: Using 'master' as the name for the initial branch"), so the push fails with "src refspec main does not match any"; same flow in 07-proyecto-tu-primer-repo.mdx lines 43-48 and 75-80.
fix: Teach `git init -b main` (or `git config --global init.defaultBranch main` once, or `git branch -M main` before the first push) in the concept text, the Terminal steps (line 51) and the Checklist; apply the same change to 07-proyecto-tu-primer-repo.mdx.

summary: Claims `node presentacion` without `.js` fails with "Cannot find module", and the quiz (line 122) marks `node app` as wrong; Node resolves the entry point with CommonJS rules and runs app.js (verified: `node app` prints the file output on Node 22.22).
fix: Replace the common-mistake with a real one (e.g. running the file from the wrong folder -> "Cannot find module"), and change the quiz so `node app.js` is correct without claiming `node app` fails (e.g. use a wrong-folder or `run app.js` distractor only).

summary: Says that without "type": "module" Node treats `import` as a SyntaxError (also line 151 and the quiz correct answer at line 172), but current LTS Node (22.12+, detection unflagged since 22.7) re-parses as ESM and only emits the MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning (verified on Node 22.22).
fix: Rephrase: without "type": "module" Node LTS detects the ESM syntax and prints a warning with a performance cost; older Node versions throw "Cannot use import statement outside a module". Update the error-detection paragraph and make the quiz ask about the warning or the recommended fix instead.

summary: Says `import add from "./math.js"` against named-only exports yields `add` undefined and then "TypeError: add is not a function"; ESM linking fails first with "SyntaxError: The requested module './math.js' does not provide an export named 'default'" (verified with Node 22.22).
fix: Replace the detection text with the real SyntaxError message raised before any code runs.

summary: "Nada dentro de la función se ejecuta al crear la Promise" is false and contradicts the rest of the sentence: the executor runs synchronously when `new Promise` is called (MDN Promise() constructor).
fix: Rewrite: the executor function runs immediately and synchronously; it starts the async work (setTimeout) and the result arrives later via resolve/reject.

summary: `listTasks()` returns the internal `tasks` array by reference, so `store.listTasks().push(...)` mutates private state, contradicting line 74 ("La única forma de leerlos o modificarlos...") and the checklist item about privacy (also lines 106 and 181 in the Playgrounds).
fix: Return a copy (`return [...tasks];` or `tasks.map((t) => ({ ...t }))`) in all three listings, or soften the privacy claim and add a common-mistake about returning internal references.

summary: Claims a switch without the `never` default "compila igual" and returns undefined; for the lesson's own `label(status): string` tsc --strict reports TS2366 "Function lacks ending return statement..." when a union member is unhandled (verified with tsc 5.9).
fix: Say that with an explicit non-undefined return type tsc already flags the missing case (TS2366); the `never` pattern matters for functions returning void or when the default must stay explicit, and it names the missing member in the error.

summary: Says strict "activa... reglas que por defecto están apagadas" and the Terminal (line 70) shows the pre-5.9 `tsc --init` output (target es2016, module commonjs, esModuleInterop); npm now installs TypeScript 7.0.2 and since TS 6.0 `strict` defaults to true (devblogs.microsoft.com/typescript/announcing-typescript-6-0), and tsc 5.9+ --init generates module nodenext/target esnext/strict/verbatimModuleSyntax.
fix: State the current default (strict is on by default since TS 6.0; keep "strict": true explicit for older toolchains), refresh the `tsc --init` output from the current compiler, and align the sample tsconfig.json with it.

summary: Says useSafeAreaInsets in the component that renders the provider returns 0; without a SafeAreaProvider above it the hook throws "No safe area value available. Make sure you are rendering <SafeAreaProvider>..." (react-native-safe-area-context src/SafeAreaContext.tsx, useSafeAreaInsets).
fix: Change the symptom to the thrown error message and keep the fix (use the hook in a child of the provider).

fix: Say: install it with `npx expo install @expo/vector-icons` (Snacks on SDK 55 resolve it via dependencies), and move the SDK 56 migration callout (line 102) next to this sentence, mentioning @react-native-vector-icons/* and expo-symbols.
